runtime.measured_on: existing Railway prism-runtime in temporary directory with scratch DB; preactivation

measurement.environment: Railway prism-runtime temporary directory, scratch DB; production untouched
notes: Cold and warm fetches are short samples, not a 24h bandwidth measurement.
Source publication/update times do not establish first public availability.
Initial accepted items are prospective Prism receipts, never backdated.

runtime.network_notes: Incoming payload is not Railway billable egress. HTTP/TLS headers are excluded from body counters. Use 0.1 GB/month outbound allowance, not claimed measured.
runtime.storage_projection_assumption: 100 accepted observations/day at 25KB combined receipt/ledger =75 MB/month; illustrative upper scenario, not a measured event arrival rate.
runtime.cost_gate: PASS: £0 data subscriptions; expected incremental resources below $2.50/month in existing service.
limitations: Short live benchmark rather than billed month or steady-state deployment delta.
Existing ingester reused; no new permanent DB process.
Peak import/shared-memory accounting differs from Railway billable memory.
Event-driven DB and reaction overhead varies with event arrival; budget enforced by existing 2-second collector.

design_principles: Fast deterministic/public feeds are the primary event-discovery layer.
Work is a slower semantic layer, not the primary trigger for short-horizon execution.

production_activation.limitations: Short sample; incoming body counters exclude HTTP/TLS overhead. Infrastructure estimate remains conservative scratch-benchmark projection, not measured bill.
